text.p: Mexican brokerage Banamex-Accival (Banacci) said on Monday it had lowered its ratings on two Mexican beverage firms.
Embotelladores del Valle de Anahuac SA (Emvasa) was lowered from buy to neutral, while Coca-Cola Femsa (KOF) was lowered to reduce from neutral.

Analysts Adriana Neriga and Angel Hernandez said in a report: "Even considering KOF estimates its operating cash flow will grow 16 percent this year, we think the stock price has gotten ahead of itself after rising 19.4 percent this month...."
They added Emvasa's stock price had also risen sharply in recent weeks.
Emvasa B shares rose 28 centavos to 5.92 pesos on the Mexican bourse on Monday, while KOF L shares were unchanged at 33 pesos.
